frictions.description: Cookie consent modal continuously reappears and blocks all workspace card interactions. The Accept all button appears in snapshot but cannot be clicked through agent-browser click commands. JavaScript-based dismissal approaches also did not fully resolve the blocking.
frictions.resolution: Attempted: pressing Escape, clicking backdrop, hiding fixed overlays via JavaScript, setting localStorage cookie values. None fully resolved the blocking issue for workspace card double-click actions.

frictions.description: Backend API returning 500 Internal Server Error on multiple /api/* routes. This would prevent mutations (create, archive, move) from working even if UI interactions were possible.
frictions.resolution: Backend appears to be in an unhealthy state. The convex backend process is running on port 3210 but returning 500 errors.

summary: Tested 10 assertions: 0 passed, 0 failed, 10 blocked. All assertions blocked by two issues: (1) Cookie consent modal continuously blocking all workspace card interactions - unable to double-click to enter workspaces or right-click for context menus; (2) Backend API returning 500 errors on multiple routes, which would prevent any mutations from working even if UI interactions were possible. Screenshots captured showing page state with multiple workspaces visible but inaccessible due to blocking overlays.
